facts.text: Cove Brushed Nickel Grey Leatherette + Pumice Stone Grey Fabric 3 Seater Sofa + Lounger.
Dual-tone upholstery in Nickel Grey and Pumice Stone; the listed materials are fabric and leatherette.
The lounger can be moved to the right or left side.
Features bouncy zig-zag springs and 5-inch curated foam.
Dimensions: 249 cm × 158.5 cm × 93 cm (length × width × height).
Listed warranty: 3 years; the warranty is conditional and applies to manufacturing defects under intended usage conditions.
Assembly is required and is provided by Duroflex experts.
